The '''Crescent Canyon tech depot''' was a supply depot used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that was built into [[Icequake Ridge]] on the southern edge of the [[Desolation Plains]] in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth's]] [[Whiterock Wastes]].
